description: Ministry of Highways and Investment Promotion - Order to declare that Kottawa Kadawatha Section of Outer Circular Highway to be a National Highway
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It contains a legal order (under section 8) declaring a specific road section as a National Highway and rescinding a previous order. While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory action being taken under statutory authority. The content includes legal instruments, statutory requirements, and regulatory declarations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
